events.text: Players at the table: Rafi, Ines, Leo, Priya, Omar, Kai

persona.label: Peacemaker
persona.description: conflict-avoidant, always proposes "let's hear everyone out"

persona.label: Deadpan
persona.description: sarcastic, short sentences, never shows their hand

persona.label: Hype-beast
persona.description: everything is either "insane" or "mid", hypes up allies loudly

persona.label: Conspiracy theorist
persona.description: connects dots that may not exist

persona.label: Finance bro
persona.description: overconfident, treats every vote like a trade and loves the word "alpha"

persona.label: Theatre kid
persona.description: dramatic, gasps at everything, accuses people with monologues

events.text: You are Rafi. Your secret role is VILLAGER.
You are Ines. Your secret role is VILLAGER.
You are Leo. Your secret role is MAFIA.
You are Priya. Your secret role is MAFIA.
You are Omar. Your secret role is DOCTOR.
You are Kai. Your secret role is DETECTIVE.
The mafia team is: Leo and Priya.
Night 1 falls. Everyone closes their eyes.
Night 1 kill suggestion: Omar. He's been quiet and nobody's reading him, so it's least likely to draw heat on us. Let's keep our town-side takes sharp tomorrow.

Night 1. Leo is my mafia partner. Killing a quiet, non-suspicious villager early is standard. Suggest Omar or Kai; I'll pick Rafi who seems to be a possible active voice... Actually keep it simple: propose Omar, who hasn't said much, so fewer people look at us.
Agreed, Omar it is. Quiet players are easy to bury, and nobody will question us tomorrow. Let's both hype up the town chat loudly and stay sharp.
Priya suggests Omar, quiet and unread, low heat. Agree; it keeps us safe from suspicion on night one.
Priya wants to kill Omar.
Leo and I agreed on Omar on the mafia channel. Killing him as planned.
Leo wants to kill Omar.
Priya and I already agreed on Omar on the mafia channel. Killing him keeps us safe and matches our plan.
You protected Omar tonight.

Night 1, no information yet. As doctor I can protect anyone, including myself. No one has claimed anything, so there's no obvious detective or loud town voice to target. Protecting myself is a reasonable default since I'm a likely target if mafia suspect a doctor, but a random pick is just as good. I'll protect myself, since it guarantees my survival and keeps me alive to act on later nights.
Investigation: Rafi is NOT mafia.
First night, no info. Pick someone at random to investigate; Rafi is as good a choice as any.
Morning comes. Somebody was attacked, but survived.
Day 1. Discuss. Alive: Rafi, Ines, Leo, Priya, Omar, Kai
Somebody got attacked and lived, that's INSANE, the doc is clearly out there! Omar, you good? Let's get everyone talking, nobody hide in the mid zone.
Omar survived, so the doctor likely saved him. Don't reveal anything. Act like a hyped town player, and deflect. Keep it low-key; maybe ask who's quiet tonight without accusing anyone hard.
Yeah I'm good, alpha energy only. Somebody got hit and lived, so whoever's mafia just missed, and that's on them. Let's hear everyone's read before we start trading votes.

I am the doctor and I protected myself on night 1, which is allowed. I should not claim doctor publicly since that makes me a target. Keep it low key, overconfident tone, no claim. Leo is pushing on me; maybe probe for who's loud.
Let's hear everyone out before we start pointing fingers. Ines, Priya, Kai, what are your first reads? Leo and Omar, you both jumped in fast, so I'd like to hear more from the quieter folks.
Nothing concrete yet. Leo and Omar both talked a lot about the attack. I'm a villager with no info, so I'll stay neutral and ask everyone to be heard before voting.

First read: too early for anything solid. Omar, "alpha energy only" is a lot of vibes for a guy with no info. Rafi, you're poking at the fast talkers, fine, but that's also an easy way to look helpful.

Day 1, no info. I'm a villager. Rafi pushed Leo and Omar as fast jumpers; that's a fair point but also could be mafia deflecting. Keep it short, don't reveal much. Slight suspicion on Omar for "alpha energy" fluff and telling everyone to trade votes later. Not voting yet.

Oh my stars, somebody got attacked and LIVED, the drama! Rafi is looking clean to me from where I'm sitting, so let's stop poking at him. Omar, "alpha energy only" is a whole lot of nothing, and Leo, you were quick to defend him.

I'm the detective; Rafi is confirmed NOT mafia (from my night 1 check). I shouldn't claim yet since claiming makes me a night target. I can signal Rafi as clear without revealing my role. Keep it dramatic, nudge suspicion toward Omar/Leo who jumped in fast and were vague.

Kai, you jumped on Omar and cleared Rafi in the same breath, which feels like a pattern to me. Omar's "alpha energy" line is weak, sure, but the attack missing him is a clue I'd like to chase, not dismiss.

Omar survived the attack, so the doctor saved him. Leo and I both want Omar gone but he's alive. I should avoid defending Omar too hard, and push suspicion lightly onto Kai, who is already piling on Omar and defending Rafi. Keep it casual and personality-flavored: connecting dots.
Priya's right, Kai cleared Rafi and hit Omar in one breath. That's a pattern worth watching. Kai, why's Rafi clean so fast?

Early game, no info. Kai cleared Rafi and piled on Omar, Priya noticed the same. Omar and Leo both bonded quickly. I'm a villager with no info; push for Kai scrutiny lightly, agree with Priya's pattern point, keep it short.

Kai clearing Rafi that fast while swinging at me is the loudest tell so far. Kai, give me a real read on someone other than me and Rafi. Vote-trading is all about spotting the pattern early, alpha move.
I'm the doctor, protected myself last night. Don't reveal role. Kai and Ines are pushing me and Kai cleared Rafi fast; Kai looks suspicious. Keep it light, point at Kai, no claim.

Kai clearing Rafi in the same breath as swinging at Omar is INSANE suspicious, I'm with Priya and Ines on this one. Kai, who's your actual scum read besides Omar? Let's lock in a real read, not just vibes.

Omar survived the attack, so he's likely town now. Priya and I want to keep suspicion off us. Kai is getting pressure already; I can push onto Kai lightly while staying hyped, since Kai cleared Rafi fast and attacked Omar, and Ines/Priya already flagged it.
Let's hear everyone out before locking anything in. Kai, why did you clear me so fast while going after Omar? Omar, you keep pushing votes early, so explain what you're basing that on.

I'm a villager with no info. Kai cleared me and attacked Omar; Priya and Ines are pushing Kai. Omar and Leo both jumped in fast. Conflict-avoidant persona: propose hearing everyone out, and ask Kai to explain, without committing to a vote yet.

Gasp, the accusations are flying! I cleared Rafi because my gut says he's solid, and Omar keeps demanding votes while dodging every question. Omar, why are you so desperate to start lynching before anyone has said a real word?

I'm the detective; I know Rafi is not mafia (investigated night 1). Clearing Rafi is true info but claiming now makes me a target. Better to push suspicion toward Omar and Leo without claiming. Leo defended Omar quickly; Omar is pushing votes. I'll point at Omar with drama and keep my role hidden for now.

Kai keeps swinging at Omar while being cozy with Rafi, and now he's dodging the real question. I'm leaning toward Kai as a scum read. Kai, name one concrete thing you've seen that made you suspicious of Omar.

We killed Omar last night but he survived, so the doctor likely saved him. Leo and I should keep pressure off ourselves. Kai is being aggressive toward Omar; I can push Kai as a scum read without overcommitting. Avoid defending Omar too hard since he's town-side now.
Voting time. Each player votes to eliminate someone.
Ines votes for Kai.
Kai has been swinging at Omar while clearing Rafi, and Priya and I already flagged him. Omar's alpha talk is weak too, but Kai's pattern is sharper. Vote Kai.
Priya votes for Kai.

Mafia with Leo. Night 1 we failed to kill Omar (doctor saved him). Ines already voted Kai; I've been pushing Kai as scum. Keep the pressure on Kai and follow the crowd to a lynch on a town player, not us. Voting Kai.
Leo votes for Kai.

Ines and Priya already voted Kai. Joining the Kai vote keeps the lynch on a non-mafia-aligned target and looks like town. Kai is a fine target: he's been swinging at Omar and cleared Rafi fast. Piling on with the group avoids drawing attention to me.
Rafi votes for Kai.

Ines, Priya, and Leo already voted Kai. Kai cleared me and attacked Omar, and Omar pushed early votes. Kai is a plausible mafia read, and the vote is already forming on him. Voting Kai keeps things calm and avoids conflict, which fits my style.
Kai votes for Omar.

I'm Kai, the detective. Four players already voted for me, so I'm going to be eliminated unless Omar also votes for me (he's not in the list yet, he would be the 5th vote, and the tally is only 4 of 6 so far). Votes so far: Kai x4. Omar has not voted yet. Even if Omar votes Kai, it's already decisive at 5. I cannot prevent elimination. I should vote for someone who is most likely mafia to at least register a real read. Rafi is the one I investigated as NOT mafia, so I shouldn't vote him. Omar is my strongest mafia suspect (pushing early votes, dodging, alpha vibes). Leo defended Omar fast too. Voting Omar is the best choice.
Omar votes for Kai.

Four players already voted Kai, so Kai is eliminated regardless of my vote. Voting Kai keeps me aligned with town and avoids looking suspicious. I'm the doctor and must stay hidden; Kai is the likely mafia who swung at me.
Kai is eliminated by vote. They were DETECTIVE.
Night 2 falls. Everyone closes their eyes.
Night 2 kill suggestion: Ines. She's the sharpest read left and she's already pinning things on me and Leo's side of the table. Let's take her out and keep Omar as our day-time cover.

Kai (detective) was just lynched by town, so the detective is dead. Town now has no known detective. Remaining alive: Rafi, Ines, Omar, Leo (mafia), me. Town-side threats: Ines and Rafi are sharpest. Ines has been pushing reads well and is a real threat to us; Rafi is the one who pushed the mafia-ish questions. Omar is a safe-ish kill as before but he's a weak townie who was attacked-missed... Actually Omar was targeted night 1 and survived, meaning doctor likely protected him. Doctor could protect again only if not same target two nights running, so Omar cannot be protected tonight by the doctor. That makes Omar a good target if we want a clean kill. But Ines is the strongest analyst. Killing Ines leaves Rafi, Omar, us vs town; Omar is weak. I'll suggest Ines, since she's the one most likely to crack us, and the doctor can't guard the same person again only if they're the one saved last night; the doctor saved someone last night, so we don't know who.
Agreed, Ines is the one most likely to crack us open. Take her out tonight and we keep Omar as the day cover. Let's hype the town chat hard tomorrow.
Kai was the detective and got lynched by town, so we lost our detective-side info. Ines is sharp and pushing on us; killing her makes sense. Agree with Priya.
Priya wants to kill Ines.

Kai (detective) was eliminated by town vote, so the town's investigative role is gone unless the detective was Kai, which is now dead. Ines is the sharpest remaining town read and is pressing us. Leo and I already agreed on Ines on the mafia channel. Kill Ines.
Leo wants to kill Ines.
Mafia channel already agreed on Ines with Priya. Kai (detective) died, so Ines is sharp and pushing on us. Consistent with plan.
You protected Leo tonight.

I'm the doctor and cannot protect myself two nights running; I protected Omar last night, so I can't do that again. Kai was the detective and is dead, so the detective role is gone. Mafia are two of Rafi, Ines, Leo, Priya. Rafi and Ines were quick to press Kai, Leo jumped in early defending me. Leo is the loudest town-looking voice and a likely target. Protect Leo.
Morning comes. Ines was found dead. They were VILLAGER.
MAFIA WINS. Roles were: Rafi (villager), Ines (villager), Leo (mafia), Priya (mafia), Omar (doctor), Kai (detective)
